question: Does full-LC v2-surrogate RMSE rank the 79k s092 cross-cloud survivors toward truth?
hypothesis: Full-LC surrogate RMSE scoring isolates the truth pair from the s092 prefilter survivors.
narrative_md: RETRACTED by s097: this conclusion was a times[0]==0 propagator-gauge bug — re-run on correct geometry REVERSES it (most-truth-like survivor ranks 4/79,443, full-LC RMSE is a STRONG discriminator). The original (buggy) finding: full-LC RMSE failed to rank truth up (truthlike rank 31,515/79,443, top-100 within-10° = 0). Truth's own LC fits to 0.0102 mag. Scoring consumes only the observed LC; truth used only for the floor/labels.
